contentHtml:
Insurance Reports

Did you accidentally had your computer damaged and you need help coming up with insurance reports for your insurance company? We can come up with a full report right away!

We do acknowledge how infuriating and difficult it could be to deal with insurance company in events that you need to make a claim. We at Computer Repairs Stretton will help you make a full diagnosis and write up a detailed and concise report for your insurer and make the claim process easier.

It is sometimes a cheaper choice to have your damaged equipment replaced than having it repaired. If your computer, laptop or other IT equipment survives a damage but causing it to require a replacement, insurance companies will often suggest that you bring your faulty device to a repair center to have it diagnosed and to carried out a quote for a repair. Computer Repairs Stretton offers support for both types of insurance claims to perfectly satisfy your needs. We can make reports to carry out repairs for your insurance company as well as replacement claim reports, especially if it is the best and cheapest option to be.

We provide insurance reports for all brands of laptops and computers ranging from Acer, Apple, Asus, Dell, HP, Lenovo, MSI, Samsung, Sony and Toshiba.

Computer insurance reports Stretton offers support for common damages that you can claim

  • Water damage
  • Fire damage
  • Dropped equipment
  • Power surge damage
  • Smashed equipment
  • Accidental damage
  • Malicious damage

We value our customers’ specific choice and need that is why we always aim to provide high quality and expert service. Our insurance report includes policies and conditions that are in place to protect you as a customer, your insurance company and ourselves. All insurance reports will be made with comprehensive assessment and diagnosis that will enable you to validate your claim with your insurer for either repair or replacement.

In times that your insurer decided for a claim to repair the item, we will have your item repaired with the best of our skills and expertise. We also perform Beyond Economical Repair (BER) reports in circumstances that the item cannot be repaired economically.

If there is a need for data recovery, Computer Repairs Stretton can also send our expert technician to recover your important data. You can be confident that we will protect all your personal and confidential data from a potential security breach all throughout the data recovery process.

For all your questions and inquiries, call us at 0477 319 160 with no call out fees! Computer Repairs Stretton is open 7 days a week from 7am up to 10pm and even on holidays.
